weaknesses.title: PUSHD/POPD/DIRSTACK are process-scoped only
weaknesses.detail: Action dispatch re-execs cubalc each time. enter then put in separate runs loses stack; leave sees empty. Agents must compound visit in one process.
weaknesses.repro: enter; new process leave → empty stack

weaknesses.title: KINDSTR missing is OK=1 not soft-fail
weaknesses.detail: Missing path → LAST=missing KIND_N=0 OK=1. Empty path OK=0. Agents treating OK as exist fail; dual-branch needed with CANACCESS/EXIST.

weaknesses.title: KINDSTR uses lstat — link not target kind
weaknesses.detail: Symlink to file is kind=link not file. Agents that want target type need READLINK+KINDSTR chain. No KINDFOLLOW form.

weaknesses.title: No WITHDIR / ENTER…LEAVE block form
weaknesses.detail: Must hand-roll PUSHD … POPD and recover on mid-fail. visit write fail path needs explicit POPD. Easy to leak cwd on EXIT.
weaknesses.repro: PUSHD; EXIT 2 leaves process in workdir

weaknesses.title: HAS on CWD paths is basename false-friend prone
weaknesses.detail: HAS cwd site matches any path containing site. Prefer ENDS/BASENAME EQS for site checks.

weaknesses.title: work action MKDIR may create deep paths agents did not intend
weaknesses.detail: work /no/such/site may succeed if MKDIR is -p style; enter then works. File-as-workdir is the reliable enter-fail case.

workarounds: Compound enter+relative I/O+leave in one process (visit)
Treat KINDSTR missing as soft miss via EQS not OK
POPD in every fail path after PUSHD
language_gaps: Persistent or plate-backed DIRSTACK across runs
WITHDIR path … END auto-pop on fail/exit
Safe relative plate root bound to WORK
issues_faced: stack empty across re-exec — core lesson; visit compounds
